profile.headline: Software Engineer | Software Infrastructure
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer, I spearhead the design and implementation of secure and scalable solutions for one of the leading cryptocurrency platforms in the world. With over 20 years of experience in enterprise applications and backend development, I have a strong grasp of blockchain technology, cloud services, and web frameworks.

I have successfully delivered multiple projects that enhanced the security, efficiency, and performance of Bittrex's applications and services, including an OAuth service, a fiat service, and a user balance snapshot feature. I have also contributed to cutting-edge prototypes and migrations for Edgenuity and Pling Games, leveraging the latest cloud platforms and patterns. I am passionate about solving complex problems and creating innovative products using blockchain technology.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and optimized RESTful and WebSocket APIs, achieving a 30% improvement in response times and supporting high-volume, real-time data processing for a global user base.
• Directed the development and implementation of fiat currency services, processing daily transactions worth millions of dollars with enhanced accuracy and security.
• Engineered a comprehensive system for daily user balance snapshots, successfully back- populating of data and managing over 30 billion records in Cosmos DB, which improved data integrity and access speed.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Framework · Software Design · Microsoft SQL Server · Software Infrastructure · Microservices · C# · NoSQL · .NET Core · Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Software Engineering Consultant
positions.description:
• Expertly moved 5 web apps to the cloud, including 3 databases, reducing on-premise server usage and achieving 25% cost savings for the company.
• Successfully implemented AWS batch application, resulting in 50% faster daily file processing and improved overall efficiency.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Framework · Software Design · Microsoft SQL Server · Software Infrastructure · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · C# · dotnet · AWS DMS · MongoDB

positions.title: Lead Blockchain Consultant
positions.description:
• Consulted on Blockchain technology for crowdfunding investment platforms, integrating Azure services.
• Pioneered the development of Dapp environments using Docker containers and Azure Container Registry.
positions.insights: Skills: Blockchain · C# · web3.js · Microsoft Azure · Smart Contracts · Node.js

positions.title: Blockchain Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Configured Parity for Proof of Work and Proof of Authority consensus in Azure environments. 
• Developed Smart Contract and unit tests with Truffle, alongside integration tests with Parity. 
• Utilized Azure Resource Manager Templates for managing various Azure resources.
positions.insights: Skills: Solidity · NoSQL · Truffle Framework · Microsoft Azure · Smart Contracts · Node.js

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led a team in developing a mobile API and automating manual processing.
• Mentored and trained engineers in solid design principles and conducted regular code reviews. • Designed core applications API/SDK for violation processing management and Fleet data.
• Produced SSRS reports tailored to the needs of various clients.
• Implemented Single Sign-On with partner applications using SAML 2.0 in C#.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed Invoice generator using Crystal report server which performs billing to 5,000 drivers every day.
Implemented in ASP.NET customer services application which provides billing and call center information.
Designed and implemented Single Sing-On(SSO) with partner application by SAML 2.0 in C#.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
The project was to develop web application for hospital environment with RFID technology. The application reflected the hospital requirements and stay previous UI but improved functionalities. The site could track location of RFID tags (EPC Gen2 and UWB from Ubisense) and update status of patients.
The application is N-Tier architecture windows application developed for customizing the personal. The system is analysis / monitor application for building structure. The application is able to control patrol robots to collect architecture information and track the location of the robot to improve automatic patrol system using various shortest path Algorithms.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Washington State Korean-American Education and Culture Foundation
volunteerExperiences.description: Passionate about leveraging technology to enrich cultural education, I currently serve as the IT Director and a member of the Executive Committee for the Korean American Education Culture organization. With a steadfast commitment to fostering an environment where technology and culture intersect, I aim to empower our community through education and innovation.

company.name: Washington State Korean-American Education and Culture Foundation
